annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国土交通省 (Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism)
annotation.summary_en: Japanese MLIT ministerial ordinance (Reiwa 4 No. 57) governing registered inspection bodies for unmanned aircraft under the Civil Aeronautics Act. It sets registration procedures, inspection standards for airframe and type certification, rules of inspection procedure, record-keeping, and handover of duties between bodies and the Minister. In force 5 December 2022.
key_provisions_or_claims: Sets application requirements and documents for registration as an unmanned aircraft inspection body
Defines inspection methods for airframe certification and type certification, including safety and uniformity standards
Requires approval of inspection operation rules and reporting of results to the Minister
Requires books to be kept for three years and notification of officer changes
Provides for handover of inspection duties between bodies and the Minister
annotation.title_clean: 無人航空機登録検査機関に関する省令
annotation.title_en: Ministerial Ordinance on Registered Inspection Bodies for Unmanned Aircraft
